title: Add website template: index.php entry point
description: Create the PHP entry point for the website template. This is a basic router that loads database configuration and dispatches requests to controllers.
acceptanceCriteria: File returns a simple homepage response for the root path

steps.details: Create src/templates/website/public/index.php with: <?php require_once __DIR__ . '/../config/database.php'; $uri = parse_url($_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'], PHP_URL_PATH); $uri = rtrim($uri, '/'); if ($uri === '' || $uri === '/') { require __DIR__ . '/../templates/home.php'; } else { http_response_code(404); require __DIR__ . '/../templates/404.php'; }
Create src/templates/website/templates/home.php with a simple HTML page using the layout: <?php require_once __DIR__ . '/layout.php'; ?> (or inline the layout if not using includes).
Create src/templates/website/templates/404.php with a 404 Not Found response page.

technicalNotes: parse_url is used instead of direct $_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'] access to strip query strings from routing
The router pattern here is the simplest possible — more complex routing can be added as the project grows
